ONE RR FULL CARBON INTEGRATED The integrated full carbon ONE RR handlebar, designed for the Pro Road Racing world, comes standard on all setups. The stem and handlebar are integrated into a single structure that guarantees maximum cable integration, with a clear advantage in terms of rigidity, comfort and world-class aerodynamics. Weight 430 grams. AVAILABLE SIZES40CC x 90 – 100 42CC x 90 – 100 – 110 – 120 44CC x 110 – 120

Discover the new ITM wheels Find out more about the ITM wheels developed exclusively for Bottecchia. FIND OUT MORE

RACING TECHNOLOGIES DEPARTMENT More aerodynamic and lighter, EMME 5 has an extraordinary weight-stiffness ratio, the best ever achieved before. 5% more aerodynamic efficiency and - 8% weight of the frameset compared to the previous EMME 4. This improvement was achieved thanks to a particular study of the carbon layup applied to the Monolith production technology, which allows for the creation of a true monocoque by eliminating the joint points and obtaining a perfect distribution of the carbon fibres along the entire frame. The complete integration of the wiring into the headset and fork also ensures high aerodynamic efficiency, also optimised by the differentiated development of the down tube section and the dedicated carbon seat post with drop section. The rear triangle design is also brand new - ALL IN ONE PIECE, designed for perfect transmission of forces from the bottom bracket to the rear wheel axle. Wheel clearance increased up to 32 mm. IDEAL FOR EMME 5 is the quintessence of racing road bikes. Designed for professionals, it is perfect for long distances. Lightness and stiffness make it fast uphill, where it can make the difference. Reactive and fast, it is particularly effective in sprints, but also precise and stable on descents, where all its aerodynamics are enhanced. PERFECT FOR YOU IF Technically perfected in detail, EMME 5 is perfect for all road riders who do not compromise when it comes to performance.

What's your size? Check out our SIZE GUIDE for an indication of the frame size that is best for you. Remember that a biomechanical evaluation with your local authorized dealer is always recommended.
